reviews.visual_conclusion: All three files belong to one Mega Drapion development line centered on a giant hypodermic-needle tail and Nerve Agent identity. The cybernetic sheet is an earlier, more cyberpunk interpretation; the later Mega sheets deliberately reduce the cyberpunk treatment while preserving the same poison-injector concept.
reviews.distinct_design_policy: Keep the cybernetic interpretation as a preserved design option/reference because its styling is materially different enough to revisit, but do not count it as a separate roster identity unless the user later promotes it to one.
